name: protocol
description: Your Valorant team's protocols, map by map: search, read, match sheets and ready-made prompts. Local, private, nothing irreversible.
long_description:
protocol is a coach's notebook for Valorant: setups, executes, retakes, lineups and anti-strats, organized map by map in a single local file.

This extension lets Claude search and read the notebook, pull the match sheet of a map, and run ready-made prompts (summarize a protocol, find its weaknesses, prepare or debrief a match, tidy a pasted text into a note).

**Read-only by default.** Turn on *Allow writing* to let Claude create, update, pin, move or trash notes — nothing is irreversible: a trashed note goes to the notebook's bin, and a rewritten note leaves its previous version there. Writing works even while the protocol window is open.

No network, no account, no API key: Claude talks to the program on your computer.
